lines: Where have you been? Were you thrown into a different dimension than me?
When I was doing weight training the scenery suddenly changed, and before I noticed, I was in a forest full of huge, jagged rocks...
I got caught by those monsters and was about to be turned into a side dish!
Yeah!? But wait a sec, is that the front gate of Gosha Academy!? I was able to get back home!
I quietly pointed at the young Sakura-sensei.
S-Sakura-sensei...? Aren't you a bit young!?!
Hmm? You brothers are pretty rude...
Sh-She really is younger! But what does she mean by brothers...!?
Oh yes, Shikanosuke! Come here a second!! ...*whisper, whisper, whisper*...
And Rinko-senpai as well! Just go with it, trust me!!
Umm... p-pardon me... I... I'm Akiyama Shikanosuke, the youngest brother...
Ahaha! I knew it, you guys look so alike!
Eh... I-I guess we do...? Hehe...
Shikanosuke furrowed his brows, looking somewhat perplexed.
Ah!! Where have you been hiding?!
≪I was sure I would be able to easily squash you, but you are surprisingly bothersome little vermin.≫
Shikanosuke screamed and backed away upon seeing the octopus.
Calm down, Shikanosuke, he talks and looks like a villain, but he's not hostile.
Th-That's not true!!! I know these guys!! I was being held captive by them in the world I just came from!
And those monsters from before are this Octo-guy's subordinates!!!
